rages_a1.name: Rages
rages_a1.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Tobit 4:1 (KJV): “In that day Tobit remembered the money which he had committed to Gabael in Rages of Media,”

ragau_a2.name: Ragau
ragau_a2.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 1:5 (KJV): “Even in those days king Nabuchodonosor made war with king Arphaxad in the great plain, which is the plain in the borders of Ragau.”

elymais_a3.name: Elymais
elymais_a3.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Tobit 2:10 (KJV): “And I knew not that there were sparrows in the wall, and mine eyes being open, the sparrows muted warm dung into mine eyes, and a whiteness came in mine eyes: and I went to the physicians, but they helped me not: moreover Achiacharus did nourish me, until I went into Elymais.”

thisbe_a5.name: Thisbe
thisbe_a5.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Tobit 1:2 (KJV): “Who in the time of Enemessar king of the Assyrians was led captive out of Thisbe, which is at the right hand of that city, which is called properly Nephthali in Galilee above Aser.”

bethulia_a6.name: Bethulia
bethulia_a6.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 4:6 (KJV): “Also Joacim the high priest, which was in those days in Jerusalem, wrote to them that dwelt in Bethulia, and Betomestham, which is over against Esdraelon toward the open country, near to Dothaim,”

kona_a7.name: Kona
kona_a7.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 4:4 (KJV): “Therefore they sent into all the coasts of Samaria, and the villages and to Bethoron, and Belmen, and Jericho, and to Choba, and Esora, and to the valley of Salem:”

choba_a8.name: Choba
choba_a8.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 4:4 (KJV): “Therefore they sent into all the coasts of Samaria, and the villages and to Bethoron, and Belmen, and Jericho, and to Choba, and Esora, and to the valley of Salem:”

cyamon_a9.name: Cyamon
cyamon_a9.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 7:3 (KJV): “And they camped in the valley near unto Bethulia, by the fountain, and they spread themselves in breadth over Dothaim even to Belmaim, and in length from Bethulia unto Cynamon, which is over against Esdraelon.”

betomasthaim_a10.name: Betomasthaim
betomasthaim_a10.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 15:4 (KJV): “Then sent Ozias to Betomasthem, and to Bebai, and Chobai, and Cola and to all the coasts of Israel, such as should tell the things that were done, and that all should rush forth upon their enemies to destroy them.”

egrebeh_a11.name: Egrebeh
egrebeh_a11.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 7:18 (KJV): “Then the children of Esau went up with the children of Ammon, and camped in the hill country over against Dothaim: and they sent some of them toward the south, and toward the east over against Ekrebel, which is near unto Chusi, that is upon the brook Mochmur; and the rest of the army of the Assyrians camped in the plain, and covered the face of the whole land; and their tents and carriages were pitched to a very great multitude.”

chusi_a12.name: Chusi
chusi_a12.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 7:18 (KJV): “Then the children of Esau went up with the children of Ammon, and camped in the hill country over against Dothaim: and they sent some of them toward the south, and toward the east over against Ekrebel, which is near unto Chusi, that is upon the brook Mochmur; and the rest of the army of the Assyrians camped in the plain, and covered the face of the whole land; and their tents and carriages were pitched to a very great multitude.”

mochmur_a13.name: Mochmur
mochmur_a13.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 7:18 (KJV): “Then the children of Esau went up with the children of Ammon, and camped in the hill country over against Dothaim: and they sent some of them toward the south, and toward the east over against Ekrebel, which is near unto Chusi, that is upon the brook Mochmur; and the rest of the army of the Assyrians camped in the plain, and covered the face of the whole land; and their tents and carriages were pitched to a very great multitude.”

balbaim_a14.name: Balbaim
balbaim_a14.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 7:3 (KJV): “And they camped in the valley near unto Bethulia, by the fountain, and they spread themselves in breadth over Dothaim even to Belmaim, and in length from Bethulia unto Cynamon, which is over against Esdraelon.”

bectileth_a15.name: Bectileth
bectileth_a15.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 2:21 (KJV): “And they went forth of Nineve three days’ journey toward the plain of Bectileth, and pitched from Bectileth near the mountain which is at the left hand of the upper Cilicia.”

chelous_a16.name: Chelous
chelous_a16.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 1:9 (KJV): “And to all that were in Samaria and the cities thereof, and beyond Jordan unto Jerusalem, and Betane, and Chelus, and Kades, and the river of Egypt, and Taphnes, and Ramesse, and all the land of Gesem,”

ocina_a17.name: Ocina
ocina_a17.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 2:28 (KJV): “Therefore the fear and dread of him fell upon all the inhabitants of the sea coasts, which were in Sidon and Tyrus, and them that dwelt in Sur and Ocina, and all that dwelt in Jemnaan; and they that dwelt in Azotus and Ascalon feared him greatly.”

sur_a18.name: Sur (Judith)
sur_a18.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Judith 2:28 (KJV): “Therefore the fear and dread of him fell upon all the inhabitants of the sea coasts, which were in Sidon and Tyrus, and them that dwelt in Sur and Ocina, and all that dwelt in Jemnaan; and they that dwelt in Azotus and Ascalon feared him greatly.”

sud_a19.name: Sud
sud_a19.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Baruch 1:4 (KJV): “And in the hearing of the nobles, and of the king’s sons, and in the hearing of the elders, and of all the people, from the lowest unto the highest, even of all them that dwelt at Babylon by the river Sud.”

merran_a20.name: Merran
merran_a20.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. Baruch 3:23 (KJV): “The Agarenes that seek wisdom upon earth, the merchants of Meran and of Theman, the authors of fables, and searchers out of understanding; none of these have known the way of wisdom, or remember her paths.”

modein_a21.name: Modein
modein_a21.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 2:1 (KJV): “In those days arose Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem, and dwelt in Modin.”

coelesyria_a22.name: Coelesyria
coelesyria_a22.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 10:69 (KJV): “Then Demetrius made Apollonius the governor of Celosyria his general, who gathered together a great host, and camped in Jamnia, and sent unto Jonathan the high priest, saying,”

dathema_a23.name: Dathema
dathema_a23.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:9 (KJV): “Then the heathen that were at Galaad assembled themselves together against the Israelites that were in their quarters, to destroy them; but they fled to the fortress of Dathema.”

bosor_a24.name: Bosor
bosor_a24.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:26 (KJV): “And how that many of them were shut up in Bosora, and Bosor, and Alema, Casphor, Maked, and Carnaim; all these cities are strong and great:”

chaspho_a25.name: Chaspho
chaspho_a25.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:26 (KJV): “And how that many of them were shut up in Bosora, and Bosor, and Alema, Casphor, Maked, and Carnaim; all these cities are strong and great:”

caspin_a26.name: Caspin
caspin_a26.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 2 Maccabees 12:13 (KJV): “He went also about to make a bridge to a certain strong city, which was fenced about with walls, and inhabited by people of divers countries; and the name of it was Caspis.”

maked_a27.name: Maked
maked_a27.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:26 (KJV): “And how that many of them were shut up in Bosora, and Bosor, and Alema, Casphor, Maked, and Carnaim; all these cities are strong and great:”

alema_a28.name: Alema
alema_a28.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:26 (KJV): “And how that many of them were shut up in Bosora, and Bosor, and Alema, Casphor, Maked, and Carnaim; all these cities are strong and great:”

raphon_a29.name: Raphon
raphon_a29.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:37 (KJV): “After these things gathered Timotheus another host and encamped against Raphon beyond the brook.”

ephron_a30.name: Ephron (in Gilead)
ephron_a30.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:46 (KJV): “Now when they came unto Ephron, (this was a great city in the way as they should go, very well fortified) they could not turn from it, either on the right hand or the left, but must needs pass through the midst of it.”

maapha_a31.name: Maapha
maapha_a31.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:35 (KJV): “This done, Judas turned aside to Maspha; and after he had assaulted it he took and slew all the males therein, and received the spoils thereof and and burnt it with fire.”

beth-zechariah_a32.name: Beth-zechariah
beth-zechariah_a32.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 6:32 (KJV): “Upon this Judas removed from the tower, and pitched in Bathzacharias, over against the king’s camp.”

adasa_a33.name: Adasa
adasa_a33.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 7:40 (KJV): “But Judas pitched in Adasa with three thousand men, and there he prayed, saying,”

bethbasi_a34.name: Bethbasi
bethbasi_a34.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:62 (KJV): “Afterward Jonathan, and Simon, and they that were with him, got them away to Bethbasi, which is in the wilderness, and they repaired the decays thereof, and made it strong.”

elasa_a35.name: Elasa
elasa_a35.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:5 (KJV): “Now Judas had pitched his tents at Eleasa, and three thousand chosen men with him:” Usually identified with Il'asa, near Beth-horon.

beth-zaith_a36.name: Beth-zaith
beth-zaith_a36.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 7:19 (KJV): “After this, removed Bacchides from Jerusalem, and pitched his tents in Bezeth, where he sent and took many of the men that had forsaken him, and certain of the people also, and when he had slain them, he cast them into the great pit.”

caphar-salama_a37.name: Caphar-salama
caphar-salama_a37.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 7:31 (KJV): “Nicanor also, when he saw that his counsel was discovered, went out to fight against Judas beside Capharsalama:”

akrabattene_a38.name: Akrabattene
akrabattene_a38.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 5:3 (KJV): “Then Judas fought against the children of Esau in Idumea at Arabattine, because they besieged Gael: and he gave them a great overthrow, and abated their courage, and took their spoils.”

mesaloth_a39.name: Mesaloth
mesaloth_a39.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:2 (KJV): “Who went forth by the way that leadeth to Galgala, and pitched their tents before Masaloth, which is in Arbela, and after they had won it, they slew much people.” “Mesaloth, which is in Arbela” (1 Maccabees 9:2): shown at Arbela in Galilee.

arbela_a40.name: Arbela
arbela_a40.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:2 (KJV): “Who went forth by the way that leadeth to Galgala, and pitched their tents before Masaloth, which is in Arbela, and after they had won it, they slew much people.” Arbela in Galilee, above the Sea of Galilee (Josephus, Antiquities 12.11.1).

asphar_a41.name: Asphar
asphar_a41.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:33 (KJV): “Then Jonathan, and Simon his brother, and all that were with him, perceiving that, fled into the wilderness of Thecoe, and pitched their tents by the water of the pool Asphar.”

nadabath_a42.name: Nadabath
nadabath_a42.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:37 (KJV): “After this came word to Jonathan and Simon his brother, that the children of Jambri made a great marriage, and were bringing the bride from Nadabatha with a great train, as being the daughter of one of the great princes of Chanaan.”

phasiron_a43.name: Phasiron
phasiron_a43.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:66 (KJV): “And he smote Odonarkes and his brethren, and the children of Phasiron in their tent.”

berea_a44.name: Berea (in Judea)
berea_a44.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:4 (KJV): “From whence they removed, and went to Berea, with twenty thousand footmen and two thousand horsemen.” Probably Beeroth (el-Bireh), north of Jerusalem; some read Bir Zeit.

beroea_a45.name: Beroea (Aleppo)
beroea_a45.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 2 Maccabees 13:4 (KJV): “But the King of kings moved Antiochus’ mind against this wicked wretch, and Lysias informed the king that this man was the cause of all mischief, so that the king commanded to bring him unto Berea, and to put him to death, as the manner is in that place.”

sparta_a46.name: Sparta
sparta_a46.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 14:16 (KJV): “Now when it was heard at Rome, and as far as Sparta, that Jonathan was dead, they were very sorry.”

delos_a47.name: Delos
delos_a47.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 15:23 (KJV): “And to all the countries and to Sampsames, and the Lacedemonians, and to Delus, and Myndus, and Sicyon, and Caria, and Samos, and Pamphylia, and Lycia, and Halicarnassus, and Rhodus, and Aradus, and Cos, and Side, and Aradus, and Gortyna, and Cnidus, and Cyprus, and Cyrene.”

myndos_a48.name: Myndos
myndos_a48.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 15:23 (KJV): “And to all the countries and to Sampsames, and the Lacedemonians, and to Delus, and Myndus, and Sicyon, and Caria, and Samos, and Pamphylia, and Lycia, and Halicarnassus, and Rhodus, and Aradus, and Cos, and Side, and Aradus, and Gortyna, and Cnidus, and Cyprus, and Cyrene.”

sicyon_a49.name: Sicyon
sicyon_a49.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 15:23 (KJV): “And to all the countries and to Sampsames, and the Lacedemonians, and to Delus, and Myndus, and Sicyon, and Caria, and Samos, and Pamphylia, and Lycia, and Halicarnassus, and Rhodus, and Aradus, and Cos, and Side, and Aradus, and Gortyna, and Cnidus, and Cyprus, and Cyrene.”

caria_a50.name: Caria
caria_a50.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 15:23 (KJV): “And to all the countries and to Sampsames, and the Lacedemonians, and to Delus, and Myndus, and Sicyon, and Caria, and Samos, and Pamphylia, and Lycia, and Halicarnassus, and Rhodus, and Aradus, and Cos, and Side, and Aradus, and Gortyna, and Cnidus, and Cyprus, and Cyrene.”

halicarnassus_a51.name: Halicarnassus
halicarnassus_a51.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 15:23 (KJV): “And to all the countries and to Sampsames, and the Lacedemonians, and to Delus, and Myndus, and Sicyon, and Caria, and Samos, and Pamphylia, and Lycia, and Halicarnassus, and Rhodus, and Aradus, and Cos, and Side, and Aradus, and Gortyna, and Cnidus, and Cyprus, and Cyrene.”

sampsames_a53.name: Sampsames
sampsames_a53.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 15:23 (KJV): “And to all the countries and to Sampsames, and the Lacedemonians, and to Delus, and Myndus, and Sicyon, and Caria, and Samos, and Pamphylia, and Lycia, and Halicarnassus, and Rhodus, and Aradus, and Cos, and Side, and Aradus, and Gortyna, and Cnidus, and Cyprus, and Cyrene.”

orthosia_a54.name: Orthosia
orthosia_a54.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 15:37 (KJV): “In the mean time fled Tryphon by ship unto Orthosias.”

persepolis_a55.name: Persepolis
persepolis_a55.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 2 Maccabees 9:2 (KJV): “For he had entered the city called Persepolis, and went about to rob the temple, and to hold the city; whereupon the multitude running to defend themselves with their weapons put them to flight; and so it happened, that Antiochus being put to flight of the inhabitants returned with shame.”

daphne_a56.name: Daphne
daphne_a56.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 2 Maccabees 4:33 (KJV): “Which when Onias knew of a surety, he reproved him, and withdrew himself into a sanctuary at Daphne, that lieth by Antiochia.”

tripolis_a57.name: Tripolis
tripolis_a57.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 2 Maccabees 14:1 (KJV): “After three years was Judas informed, that Demetrius the son of Seleucus, having entered by the haven of Tripolis with a great power and navy,”

mallus_a58.name: Mallus
mallus_a58.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 2 Maccabees 4:30 (KJV): “While those things were in doing, they of Tarsus and Mallos made insurrection, because they were given to the king’s concubine, called Antiochus.”

charax_a59.name: Charax
charax_a59.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 2 Maccabees 12:17 (KJV): “Then departed they from thence seven hundred and fifty furlongs, and came to Characa unto the Jews that are called Tubieni.”

mount_azotus_a60.name: Mount Azotus
mount_azotus_a60.about: Named only in the Apocrypha. 1 Maccabees 9:15 (KJV): “Who discomfited the right wing, and pursued them unto the mount Azotus.” Not the city of Azotus on the coast, but a hill near Elasa; no site is agreed (some read “Mount Azor”, Baal-hazor).
